task_description: Migrate the OrientApp native Android (Kotlin/Compose/Room) vocational-diagnostic app to a Next.js + TypeScript web app deployed on Vercel + Neon Postgres. Faithfully port the RIASEC psychometric engine, 60-question assessment, radar results, career matching, and OpenAI-compatible AI advisor. Add (1) a RAG knowledge base grounded in staff-uploaded documents (books/research) using Neon pgvector with citations, and (2) automatic QR-code generation when a new survey group (cohort) is created, linking to the cohort-scoped test form. Original Android sources under app/ are preserved; the web app lives under web/.
